svg.title: Retry with exponential backoff
svg.desc: Retry transient failures, doubling the wait each time so a struggling service can recover. Delays are shown without jitter (1s, 2s, 4s); real clients add random jitter to avoid synchronized retry storms, and cap both the delay and the attempt count (e.g. give up after 4 attempts; the cap is not drawn). Only safe-to-repeat (idempotent) calls should be retried. 1. First try: the call fails with a transient 503. 2. Wait 1s: back off 1s, then retry. 3. Wait 2s: the wait doubles to 2s; still failing. 4. Wait 4s: after 4s the retry succeeds. 5. Reset: success clears the count for the next outage.
